name: Bun ngan
summary: Bún ngan is a noodle soup of bamboo shoots and duck meat. Vietnam Tourism names it among the Vietnamese classics around Quần Ngựa in Ba Đình.
origin: Hanoi, in the Ba Đình note on Vietnam Tourism’s stadium food page.
howToEat: Noodles, bamboo shoots, and duck. A garnish list was not printed.
where: The same note names Hạnh Bún Miến Ngan at 63 Cửa Bắc, Quán Thánh, Ba Đình. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Bun ngan — Hanoi duck and bamboo noodles
seoDescription: Bún ngan in Hanoi is a noodle soup of bamboo shoots and duck. Vietnam Tourism names a door at 63 Cửa Bắc, Ba Đình.
